metadata.article_title: Cost of reference to High Court.

article.title: Cost of reference to High Court.
article.content: The costs (if any) consequent on a reference for the decision of the High Court shall be costs in the case.
article.html:

Order 46, Rule 4

The costs (if any) consequent on a reference for the decision of the High Court shall be costs in the case.
